quests.title: THE FIRST SPARK
quests.quest_giver: Master Halden, keeper of the Grand Atelier
quests.premise: A walkway to the apprentice workshop has been damaged. The town does not need a hero with a sword; it needs someone who understands how loads are carried.
quests.objective: Place six structural modules in the fabricator to begin a testable span.
quests.why: Introduce strength, geometry, the difference between a sketch and a functioning structure, and the value of recording failed prototypes.
quests.mentor: Where does the weight go? If your longest beam bends, what changes when you support its center?

quests.title: FOUR WHEELS AND A QUESTION
quests.premise: Tala's delivery cart can carry cargo, but its axle geometry makes it wobble at speed. Bring a new design to the raceway.
quests.objective: Build four wheels and at least one motor, then enter the rover test mode.
quests.why: Mass, traction, the center of mass and controlled experimental variation.
quests.mentor: Try comparing one motor with two while keeping your load identical. Note the real limitations of this teaching vehicle model.

quests.title: THE COPPERLEAF TRIAL
quests.premise: The valley needs a fast and dependable messenger when storms cut off the mountain trails.
quests.objective: Drive the rover through all the ring checkpoints in sequence without leaving the test.
quests.why: Explore steering, momentum, braking, and prototype iteration by timing a full circuit.
quests.mentor: A faster machine is not always the best machine. Does it stop predictably at a corner?

quests.title: THE HOLLOW LIGHT
quests.premise: A vein of luminous crystals has appeared at the old survey site. Record where it is found before anyone starts to mine it.
quests.objective: Reach the Crystal Deep beacon and read the geology field notes.
quests.why: Observation before extraction; mapping; the difference between hypotheses and measurements.
quests.mentor: How could you map the crystal field without damaging the surrounding habitat?

quests.title: CATCHING THE WIND
quests.premise: The hill settlement has a water wheel, but no reliable way to use the winds that arrive before the winter storms.
quests.objective: Reach the windward tower. Investigate why blade pitch and load matter.
quests.why: Energy conversion, torque, friction and conservation of energy.
quests.mentor: If the wind doubles, does the power double? What measurements would tell you?

quests.title: THE NIGHT MECHANISM
quests.premise: The astronomical clock has stopped. Its maker left a notebook of star positions and turning ratios.
quests.objective: Find the observatory and unlock the first lesson on gear ratios.
quests.why: Rotational motion, gearing, patterns, evidence and sky observation.
quests.mentor: How many turns of a small gear does it take to rotate a larger one once?

quests.title: A FOREST WORTH KEEPING
quests.premise: The town needs timber, but the oldest grove also protects its watershed and wildlife.
quests.objective: Visit the Mosswood survey marker and think about responsible harvesting.
quests.why: Ecosystems, resource management, renewable materials and stewardship.
quests.mentor: Design a small harvesting strategy that replenishes habitat faster than it removes it.

quests.title: A WORKSHOP FOR EVERYONE
quests.premise: People across the valley have brilliant ideas but need a shared workspace where they can build safely.
quests.objective: Record three completed quests and build a 16-part prototype to unlock the council's first commission.
quests.why: Collaborative engineering, design iteration, resource budgeting and documentation.
quests.mentor: Which tools should a community workshop share, and which need specialist supervision?
